name: KIC 8676988
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.0 solar radii and 1.36 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.36 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,768 K at its surface.
